summary: GTS Safety Portal end-to-end testing complete. Backend: 20/21 pytest tests passed (95%). Auth (login/me/401), hazards (list/filter/search/detail/stats/PDF), inspections (list/filter/detail/stats), meta options, file upload+serve, and 503 fall-through for create endpoints all work correctly against the live Google Sheet via public CSV. Frontend (mobile 390x844): Login → Beranda (module cards + logout) → Hazard list (34 cards) → Hazard detail (before/after photos + generate-pdf-button) → Inspeksi list (39 cards) → Inspeksi detail (open-pdf-button) → Dashboard (4 KPI tiles + charts) all render real data. Hazard create form validation works ('Deskripsi temuan wajib diisi.'). One real backend bug: /api/upload returns a URL without scheme because backend/.env is missing EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (server.py:523 uses os.environ.get('EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL', '')). One minor console warning: 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin (Did you mean transformOrigin)' from some React Native web style. No deprecated Expo packages detected in the tested flows.

critical.issue: Response 'url' has no scheme/host (returns '/api/files/...' instead of absolute URL) because EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is NOT set in /app/backend/.env. server.py:523: backend = os.environ.get('EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL', ''). This means <Image source={{uri: res.url}} /> in the app may fail to load the just-uploaded photo. Fix: add EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://hazard-reporter-3.preview.emergentagent.com to /app/backend/.env and restart backend, OR construct the absolute URL from the incoming Request in FastAPI (str(request.base_url)).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning during navigation: 'Invalid DOM property `transform-origin`. Did you mean `transformOrigin`?'. Some component passes kebab-case transform-origin instead of camelCase transformOrigin, breaking React DOM props. Cosmetic but should be tracked.

action_items: Add EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL to /app/backend/.env (or compute base URL from FastAPI Request) so /api/upload returns an absolute image URL that <Image> can render.
Track down the source of the transform-origin DOM warning (likely a react-native style using hyphenated key).

rca_of_issue: Upload URL missing scheme: backend/server.py reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from backend env, but only frontend/.env has that key. When empty, the returned 'url' becomes '/api/files/<path>?token=...' (relative), which fails when opened outside the app origin (e.g. requests library, or if Image resolver doesn't prefix). Reproduction: POST multipart to /api/upload with Bearer token → response.url starts with '/api'. Fix: add EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://hazard-reporter-3.preview.emergentagent.com to /app/backend/.env and `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`.
